editorial:
Imagine finding out that your entire world is just one small piece of a much bigger puzzle. That is exactly what happens to Queen Poppy and Branch when they discover there are other Troll tribes out there, and each one loves a different kind of music. From hard rock to funky beats, the movie is a giant, colorful party that feels like a music festival on screen. You will love how the characters interact, especially as they try to figure out how to get along despite their loud differences. It is a bright, happy ride that keeps you smiling from start to finish.

The music is definitely the best part, and the animation looks crisp and polished. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, the energy never drops, making it a great pick for a lazy Sunday. If you have kids or just want something feel-good, you cannot go wrong here.
endingExplained: The story ends with a big battle where the villain, Barb, tries to steal all the music strings to rule everyone. Poppy realizes that you cannot force everyone to be the same. Instead of one song, the Trolls play all their different styles together in a huge mashup. This creates a powerful harmony that destroys the evil guitar. Barb learns that all music is good, and all the tribes finally live in peace together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves catchy songs and bright animation.
